children: Singapore's advance 3Q GDP data due Wednesday is likely to show that the economy grew 5.1% on year, according to the median forecast of 10 economists polled by The Wall Street Journal. That would be down from expansion of 5.9% for 2Q. Exports and industrial production are still supported by the artificial intelligence boom, Moody's Analytics economists say in a note. However, the Strait of Hormuz closure is weighing on manufacturing sectors that rely on chemical feedstock from the Gulf, they add. Singapore's economy is estimated to have grown 1.3% on quarter, on a seasonally adjusted basis, compared with 2Q's 1.4%, according to six polled economists. (amanda.lee@wsj.com)
